findings.statement: The fetched XENO BUNDLE_MANIFEST commits to 206 unique contained paths with byte sizes and SHA-256 identities, while the live Drive source tree contains 207 physical files because BUNDLE_MANIFEST.json omits itself from its contains array.
Using BUNDLE_MANIFEST.contains count directly as the physical Drive denominator undercounts the XENO source by one self-manifest file.

The 207 physical files collapse to 195 content identities; 10 duplicate-hash groups include deliberate language lineage copies and Claude-Code/implementation mirrors. Physical provenance must be preserved while semantic and earned-work credit is deduplicated by lineage/content.
